## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Protocol / dissector
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor

## Scope

- [ ] Focused change
- [ ] No unrelated files rewritten or deleted
- [ ] No other contributor's work overwritten

## Verification

- [ ] cargo fmt --all -- --check
- [ ] cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
- [ ] cargo test --workspace

## Safety

- [ ] Authorized testing only
- [ ] No stealth, evasion, or unauthorized control features
- [ ] AGPL-3.0-or-later compatible
